question: Does the frozen p00625 shared 16-lane middle butterfly improve a physical K4 TrellisMX-P8 encoder when installed at exactly layers 3, 20, and 22?
observation: The already-opened direct-KLD interaction pilot's lowest observed nonempty coalition was unrotated P8 on layers 3,20,22 at mean KLD 0.037635898105918886; standalone ModelOpt p00625 failed tune32, so this test is restricted to the codec interaction and does not reopen angle search.
hypothesis: Encoding W2 in the p00625 rotated basis and applying the exact staged rotation after SwiGLU will reduce mean end-to-end teacher KLD relative to an otherwise matched unrotated physical P8 overlay on the same three layers.
rivals: The layer subset, rather than rotation, explains any advantage versus stock NVFP4.
The physical trellis encoder removes the proxy-level rotation effect.
Window-level serving noise is larger than the rotation effect.
A pseudoquant advantage fails device closure because the fused native kernel still has an identity boundary.

rotation.parameterization: one layer-shared four-stage H16-wired SO(16) butterfly repeated over the 512-wide middle dimension
rotation.scope: post-SwiGLU middle only; W2 is encoded as W2 @ R

encoder.activation_order: static within each native 16-column trellis group
encoder.calibration_sampling: domain-balanced routed samples, maximum 256 per expert

experimental_unit: one conditional-fit window; token rows inside a window are subsamples

arms.unrotated_p8: fresh matched BF16 overlay with decoded physical K4 P8 weights at layers 3,20,22 and no middle rotation
arms.rotated_p8: fresh matched BF16 overlay with decoded physical K4 P8 weights at layers 3,20,22 plus exact p00625 middle rotation

held_constant: TP4, DCP4, MTP off, FP8 MLA KV, Humming MoE, eager mode
InstantTensor loading for both BF16 overlays
K4 P8 encoder, calibration, scale geometry, and layer set between unrotated and rotated arms
primary_estimand: equal-window mean of rotated_p8 KLD minus unrotated_p8 KLD
secondary_estimands: paired window wins and per-domain deltas
paired BCa 95 percent intervals as nonblocking controls

decision_rule.rotation_interaction_pass: rotated_p8 mean KLD is below unrotated_p8 mean KLD
decision_rule.combined_stock_win: rotated_p8 mean KLD is below fresh stock mean KLD
decision_rule.advance_to_fused_prologue: both rotation_interaction_pass and combined_stock_win are true
decision_rule.uncertainty: paired BCa intervals and window wins are reported but do not veto development
decision_rule.failure: If rotated_p8 does not beat unrotated_p8, reject this fixed three-layer p00625 interaction; do not search another proxy angle.

stopping: Encode all 288 experts once for each missing layer, then run all 32 windows once per arm; resume only incomplete windows with identical identities; no exclusions, substitutions, rerolls, or replacement angles.

storage.klcstore_mode: read-only source, calibration, roles, and teacher inputs; no new raw capture or build outputs

device_boundary: Pseudoquant is the first gate. The current native P8 runtime remains identity-boundary and therefore cannot serve these rotated sidecars correctly until a separate fused-prologue implementation closes to pseudoquant.
isa_cost_statement: P8 uses mxf8f6f4 at twice the NVFP4 MMA issue count; P8 is the quality product and no P4 speed claim is made by this experiment.
protected_boundary: selection, confirmation, final, and the 28 reserved confirmation logits remain unopened
k5: reserved exact 5.25-bpw quality lever; not varied in this rotation experiment
